steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Media production involves three stages: pre-production (planning, scripting, storyboarding, casting, financing), production (filming, recording, creating), and post-production (editing, effects, sound mixing, grading). | Key Fact: Financing: media products are funded through various models — studio investment, licence fee (BBC), advertising, subscription, crowdfunding, and government grants. | Key Fact: Distribution is how media products reach audiences — cinema release, broadcast, streaming, physical media, print, and digital download. Each channel has different economics and audience reach. | Key Fact: Marketing strategies include: trailers, posters, social media campaigns, press junkets, premiere events, viral marketing, influencer partnerships, and merchandising.
